answer: Require each identity to relay one distinct stream for one hour each epoch, checked by verifiers. The stream flows like a river through that identity alone: shared pipes, copied routes, or replayed traffic fail the check. Each stream carries a unique pigment marker in its header, so a farm cannot dye one flow and pass it off as many. Each receipt is signed in its log, as distinct as a quill signature. A farm of 1,000 fake identities must supply 1,000 relay hours and 1,000 links per epoch, and any identity that drops or duplicates its stream loses pending rewards plus a 40 POA deposit.
